component.name: core.openwop.workflows.assistant
component.description: WF-COS-1 — the ADR 0023 assistant's six boot-path workflows, migrated off the in-tree `registerWorkflow({...})` pin sites in `features/assistant/loops.ts` and `features/assistant/actionExecution.ts`. THREE PERCEPTION LOOPS (calendar ingest, drive ingest, morning briefing) fired by the RFC 0052 scheduler, and THREE APPROVED-ACTION EXECUTIONS (email send, calendar invite, calendar reschedule) dispatched by the winning approval claim. Each is registered chain-backed under its ORIGINAL workflowId, so the per-tenant scheduler job rows, the `EXEC_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND` dispatch and every existing run stamp keep resolving — and all six become gallery-visible and builder-editable like every other chain. NO credential or connection material lives in any node config: the ADR 0024 §4 Option-C opt-in is RUN-LEVEL (`configurable.connections`), set on the scheduler job / at dispatch, exactly as it was before the migration.
